item.name: Barricade
item.effect: Blocks zombie pathing and absorbs damage so a lane slows down before it reaches players.
item.bestUse: Buying breathing room when a wave starts pushing through one approach.
item.placementNote: Place it at a natural funnel with player or turret coverage behind it.
item.availability: Starter or basic run gear in current source lists

item.name: Steel Barricade
item.effect: Creates a stronger pathing block with more durability than a normal barricade.
item.bestUse: Holding chokepoints where zombies need to stall in front of team damage.
item.placementNote: Use it to shape a lane first, then protect it with turret angles or teammates.

item.name: Bunker
item.effect: Places a fortress shelter where players inside become invincible, regenerate HP, and gain a damage boost.
item.bestUse: Stabilizing the squad when dense waves or elite pressure would otherwise force a wipe.
item.placementNote: Drop it where teammates can keep firing from safety without blocking escape paths.

item.name: Auto Turret
item.effect: Automatically targets and shoots nearby zombies for steady extra damage.
item.bestUse: Covering a lane while players reload, kite, or watch another angle.
item.placementNote: Set it behind protection so it keeps firing instead of getting destroyed early.
item.availability: Listed in Survivor and Engineer gear sources

item.name: Flame Turret
item.effect: Sprays fire in a cone and burns multiple zombies when they group together.
item.bestUse: Punishing tight chokepoints where zombie packs move through the same space.
item.placementNote: Angle it across the funnel, not into open ground with low traffic.

item.name: Vanguard Turret
item.effect: Places a heavy turret that targets the strongest zombie with high single-target damage.
item.bestUse: Anchoring a defensive lane when elites or tougher zombies need priority damage.
item.placementNote: Protect it with barricades and keep players close enough to clear smaller enemies.

item.name: Laser Turret
item.effect: Auto-tracks zombies and fires fast red lasers at range.
item.bestUse: Adding reliable ranged pressure around a Bastion defensive hold.
item.placementNote: Keep the fight inside its firing lanes so the tracking damage stays active.

item.name: Drone
item.effect: Creates a hovering combat drone that auto-shoots zombies and can soak damage for the player.
item.bestUse: Adding mobile pressure and extra safety around Bastion setups.
item.placementNote: Stay close enough to the fight for the drone's shots and damage soak to matter.

item.name: Landmine
item.effect: Detonates when zombies step on it and deals area damage.
item.bestUse: Stopping a packed push right before it reaches a barricade or player route.
item.placementNote: Put it on predictable paths or breach points, not random empty floor.
item.availability: Starter or basic run gear in current source lists

item.name: Spikes
item.effect: Extends spikes from the ground periodically to damage nearby zombies.
item.bestUse: Softening enemies that are already being held in a chokepoint.
item.placementNote: Place it where zombies stay long enough for repeated spike hits.

item.name: Shockwave Bomb
item.effect: Releases a shockwave that knocks back and stuns zombies.
item.bestUse: Buying recovery time when a dense pack is about to break the defensive line.
item.placementNote: Use it on grouped zombies so the knockback and stun affect the whole push.

item.name: Mending Tower
item.effect: Continuously heals nearby structures within its radius.
item.bestUse: Keeping barricades and turrets alive during structure-heavy team holds.
item.placementNote: Place it behind the defensive line so it repairs without taking direct pressure.

item.name: Healing Station
item.effect: Continuously heals players standing within its radius.
item.bestUse: Sustaining teammates who need to hold a firing lane through chip damage.
item.placementNote: Keep it near the team's hold point but behind the front barricades.
